Comment: artwork-selection: sibling run prefixes in, a ranked diverse artwork slate out. SIX linear states, the family shape: every wait is ONE held waitForTaskToken state completed by bedrock-inference's waker, NO polling and NO Choice states — skips are SELF-COMPLETED tokens carrying the reason as data. Code decides (eligibility, archetype queries, ranking, dedup); the model only ORDERS pre-qualified candidates: the brief translation can re-weight within the closed vocabulary but never reach eligibility, and the vision rerank can reorder and flag within a slate but never add to it. Both held rounds submit one record each (tiny text; one staged vision record via records_s3uri — base64 frames blow the 256 KB invoke payload); use_batch is a CALLER flag (default false = sync). Timeouts are deadmen sized for the worst legitimate case: held states 93600s (the batch SLA ceiling, since use_batch=true parks a round on a batch job), machine 108000s. Readability copy of the template's inline DefinitionString; edit BOTH, the build fails on drift.

Validate sources and compile plan.Comment: Everything that can refuse refuses HERE: input shape, own-bucket rule, sibling artifact existence (shots + shot metadata required; cast persons + program structure optional), the provenance pin, flag normalization, archetype plan compilation (explicit list, else genre profile), prompt binding (degrades — the held states skip with a named reason). Persists _plan/plan.json; states pass URIs, never bodies.

Translate brief to plan amendments.Comment: HELD: the one editorial seat. The free-text selection_brief goes to bedrock-inference (one text record, caller-flagged batch/sync) for translation into the closed vocabulary; the filter state validates the result — amendments re-weight, they never reach eligibility. Self-completed skips: no brief, no bedrock gateway, prompts not bound, submit failure — every path reaches the filter.

Filter and rank candidate shots.Comment: THE selection, pure code, one retry unit: Layer A eligibility (hard filter, genre-independent — slates, on-screen text, brands, screen-in-screen, short shots, spoiler cut, program-structure spans), archetype queries over the closed vocabulary, stability ranking, cross-archetype dedup. Brief amendments are validated against the closed vocabulary before use. WRITES candidates.json.

Grab candidate frames.Comment: Pure code, stdlib only: middle JPEG of each candidate shot's frame archive (shot-segmentation per-shot tar.gz, proxy resolution) -> frames/ under the run prefix. A broken archive drops the frame, never the run. full_res source extraction is a fast-follow — the parameter is refused at the gateway until then.

Rerank frames by vision.Comment: HELD: the ONE model seat, judging only what metadata cannot see (sharpness, blur, eyes, composition). ONE staged vision record over every grabbed frame (records_s3uri — the frames cannot ride the invoke payload), all archetype groups in one request, ranked WITHIN each; the judge cannot add a frame, pick a slate, or violate the spoiler policy — it never saw those. Self-completed skips: no frames, no bedrock gateway, prompts not bound, submit failure.

Assemble artwork candidates.Comment: The product writer, AMENDS ONLY: vision ranking reorders within each archetype, unusable flags attach, the top reason is recorded — never adds, never re-qualifies. A skipped/failed rerank ships the metadata order with the reason on record: the slate is always delivered. WRITES artwork_candidates.json.
